Frequently Asked Questions

A quick guide to who I am, what I create, and how to get in touch. For the longer story, visit About Me.

The Person

Who is Aaron L. Schlossberg?

I’m Aaron L. Schlossberg, a web developer, entrepreneur, writer, and creator based in West Hartford, Connecticut. My background is in Computer Science (web design) and writing, and my interests connect technology, storytelling, knowledge, and imaginative worlds. Read more about me or explore my projects.

Link to this answer
Is Aaron L. Schlossberg the New York lawyer Aaron M. Schlossberg?

No. I am Aaron L. Schlossberg, a different person. I am not Aaron M. Schlossberg, the New York attorney known for a racist tirade against Spanish speakers in 2018. We happen to share a first and last name, but his actions and views do not represent me. I reject racism and bigotry.

This website is about my own work in technology, writing, entrepreneurship, and creative projects. You can learn about my background, my education, and my professional experience here.

Link to this answer
Where did Aaron L. Schlossberg go to college, and what did he study?

I graduated from Muhlenberg College in Allentown, Pennsylvania, in 2026, with a major in Computer Science and a minor in Innovation & Entrepreneurship. I also pursued studies in writing and art. My Education page covers more of my academic journey, and my college clubs page explores my campus involvement.

Where is Aaron L. Schlossberg based?

I’m based in Connecticut. I went to college in Allentown, Pennsylvania, and many of my projects and communities extend online. For more about my background and interests, visit About Me.

The Work

What kinds of work does Aaron do?

My work spans web development, writing, entrepreneurial projects, community building, and more. I build websites, write across creative and explanatory forms, and develop ideas such as Fiction2Reality and Mayvene, a developing question-and-answer platform. My Projects page introduces these ventures, while my résumé covers my skills and experience.

Link to this answer
What is Fiction2Reality?

Fiction2Reality is my long-term creative venture exploring how fictional worlds and spaces can become experiences people can explore, first digitally and eventually physically. Its work includes storytelling, worldbuilding, and real-world logistics, and its “fictions” span the Backrooms, liminal environments, Hogwarts, and other future ones. The physical spaces are a long-term ambition; the project page introduces the work and vision.

Link to this answer
Where can I read Aaron’s writing?

My Writings page brings together fiction, essays, explanatory and technical writing, scripts, and other written work. You can search the collection or filter by type and topic. If you enjoy speculative horror, try “1080 Paths of Least Resistance” or “Just This Once”!

Link to this answer
What are Info Sprawlings and Aaron’s “Compendium”?

Info Sprawlings is my connected collection of knowledge pages, with room for explanations, resources, and relationships between subjects. My Compendium offers shorter definitions and introductions to terms and ideas that appear throughout this website. Both reflect my interest in organizing knowledge so it is easier to explore, reuse, and share.
